articles.summary: FoxNews.com today published an opinion-editorial by Mark A. Smith, Chairman and CEO of NioCorp Developments, warning that China's current export restrictions on heavy rare earth exports are not a temporary negotiating tactic but a permanent strategic decision.
articles.title: China Is Closing the Door on Heavy Rare Earth Exports for Good, NioCorp CEO Warns in Fox News Op-Ed
